title: GFW 글로벌 식생 교란 경보 서비스 개시
snippet: Global Forest Watch launches expanded global vegetation disturbance alerts, going beyond forest loss to cover cropland, grassland, and wetland disturbance. The service uses Sentinel-2 and Landsat multispectral NDVI change detection to identify vegetation loss events globally. Builds on GLAD deforestation alerts but with broader scope covering all vegetation types.
tag_reason: GFW 식생 교란 경보 확장은 이전 미보고 신규 이벤트. 위성 기반 환경 모니터링 인프라 확장으로 SatOps/ClimateEnvironment 교차 이벤트.
